[[Raid on Kaineng Center]] | followed by = [[There Goes the Neighborhood (Hard mode)]] | map = }} Defend the palace gates in Kaineng Center against the hordes of attacking mercenaries. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Speak with Guardsman Qao Lin when you are ready for combat. * Position the Imperial Guards in defensive positions.
